independent original-seed full rewrites with deterministic alternating model allocation and no accumulated candidate history or auxiliary calls
search_design.interpretation: Exploratory whole-search-strategy comparison, not a single-feature ablation. Three repetitions do not promise precise repeatability or treatment-effect inference.
search_design.primary_budget: Common maximum of24 actually dispatched all-role provider calls with shared wall/provider-time ceilings. Report realized shortfalls; equal call caps are not equal allowance consumption.
search_design.failure_policy: Failures consume calls/time and remain in counts. Two consecutive provider transport failures stop the run; investigate a shared route/capacity failure before dispatching another repetition. No blind retry or deadline extension. Any missing, invalid or tool-violating context audit stops the run immediately and quarantines its response.
search_design.independence: Fresh database, original seed, model/session histories, Python/NumPy/bandit seeds and local request workspace per run. No candidates/recommendations transferred across runs. Native SQLite RANDOM and remote model sampling are not seed-controlled; report this limitation.
search_design.billing: Strict subscription only for every model role, local cached embeddings, zero model calls by evaluator. No paid fallback.
search_design.boundary: Per-invocation repository-context and tool restrictions must be verified before any new mutation; no global authentication/approval/sandbox configuration changes.

selection.draw_after: All search attempts terminate and nomination manifests are frozen.
selection.nominate_per_run: Up to3 completed correct distinct sources: highest mean trainingF, highest trainingS, highest trainingescape; ties earlier generation. If no valid descendant, seed fallback retained and failed discovery reported.
selection.choose: Highest mean originalF on shared selection panel, thenS, then earlier generation.
selection.call_prefix_secondary: For replicate pair i set k_i=min(actual all-role dispatches in its two arms), before selection episodes. Separately nominate using the same rule among sources with acceptance-call count<=k_i; seed prefix0. This is a realized-budget-conditional secondary analysis, not a prespecified uniform call count across repetitions.

assessment.draw_after: All selected sources, primary and secondary manifests, and analysis are frozen; case pools excluded from all model contexts.
assessment.conditions: Six full-budget winners, up to6 distinct common-call-prefix winners, original seed and handcrafted comparator; deduplicate identical source hashes for execution.
assessment.primary: Equal-repetition mean paired testF difference, full-native minus independent-rewrite, across3 replicate pairs under declared resource ceilings.
assessment.uncertainty: 10000 crossed bootstrap draws, resampling3 paired repetition blocks and512 common case IDs independently, preserving each shared draw across arms/programs; seed7109512. Also show all3 individual run contrasts and paired case intervals. Small repetition count makes intervals exploratory, not precise population guarantees.
assessment.invalids: Retain all cases and failures with original F=0; never drop an unsuccessful search.
assessment.case_retirement: Exclude every earlier private pool including Stage5 and controls assessment; no further tuning or fresh confirmation on exposed cases.

completion: Execute declared control/mechanism experiment, reporting audit, six independent search attempts, shared selection and fresh assessment, with honest unresolved/negative findings and failure accounting; synthesis follows. A route failure or unexecuted repetitions must be reported as incomplete.
